experiment_data.hypothesis: D030/P0: lr=5e-6 (10x lower than ced_kl001_r4) prevents catastrophic forgetting while maintaining CED reward improvement. Community consensus GRPO+QLoRA lr=5e-6~1e-5. Pass criteria: ckpt-20 rel_f1 > 0.30. Extra monitoring: pred_count + recall trend.

reproduce.command: bash -c "source /etc/network_turbo && export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache && export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1 && export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt && source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp && python -m freige.training.grpo_trainer --model_name /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen3-4B --sft_adapter /root/autodl-tmp/sft_output --data_dir /root/autodl-tmp/data/docred --stage 3 --tau_start 0.3 --tau_end 0.5 --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/grpo_ced_lr5e6 --num_generations 8 --reward_device cuda --per_device_batch_size 1 --gradient_accumulation_steps 16 --num_epochs 1 --learning_rate 5e-6 --seed 42 --kl_coef 0.01 --save_steps 20 --save_total_limit 20 --max_steps 200 --format_reward_weight 0.3 --f1_reward_weight 3.0 --ced_reward_weight 1.0 --num_iterations 1 --wandb_run_name grpo-s3-ced-lr5e6-r1"

experiment_data.notes: [2026-05-15 07:12] W&B 轨迹分析: step 100 出现 f1_reward 拐点 (0.016→0.093, 5.8x)，f1+ced 同步上升表明模型在学抽取而非纯 format hacking。但 ckpt-20/40 eval 均 FAIL (rel_f1 ~0.007)，训练 reward 尚未转化为 eval 抽取能力。ckpt-100 eval 是决定性验证点——eval F1 > 0.15 说明拐点真实，< 0.05 则判定 reward hacking。Training 113/200, ETA ~2h40m.
